events.title: Margaret Hamilton leads Apollo flight software
events.summary: Margaret Hamilton's MIT team shipped the Apollo Guidance Computer software used in the July 1969 Moon landing.
events.about: Hamilton pioneered software engineering as a discipline — priority scheduling, error recovery, and rigorous testing for life-critical code. Her team's work proved large, reliable software could run in embedded real-time systems.

narrative.whyChosen: Hamilton coined 'software engineering' and led mission-critical code to the Moon.
narrative.whyImportant: She established practices now standard in aerospace and safety-critical systems.
narrative.problemSolved: Nobody knew how to build and verify large programs for hardware with tiny memory.
